about: module web's mutants (wf10 SSR WEB1): each is judged by the module's laws and tests (scripts/examples modules/web) or by cmd/ergo's diagnostics case; the law or test that kills it is named in its rule, with 'only' where no other does. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./modules/web.

mutants.name: web1-notfound-soft
mutants.rule: A path that parses to no route is the 404 page with status 404, never a soft 404 (law UnknownPathIsNotFound; FixtureSiteAnswers).

mutants.name: web1-unknown-not-allowed
mutants.to: answer(req.Method, if req.Method == "GET" || req.Method == "HEAD" { 404 } else { 405 }, site.NotFound(req.Path))
mutants.rule: An unknown path is 404 for every method, not 405 (law UnknownPathIsNotFound only: the fixture posts to a route).

mutants.name: web1-head-body
mutants.from: return http.Response{Status: status, Header: header, Body: ""}
mutants.to: return http.Response{Status: status, Header: header, Body: html.Render(page)}
mutants.rule: HEAD answers with no body (law HeadIsGetWithoutBody; FixtureSiteAnswers).

mutants.name: web1-head-header-dropped
mutants.from: return http.Response{Status: status, Header: header, Body: ""}
mutants.rule: HEAD answers with GET's header (law HeadIsGetWithoutBody only: the fixture reads no HEAD header).

mutants.name: web1-405-without-allow
mutants.rule: Another method on a route is 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD (law OtherMethodIsNotAllowed; FixtureSiteAnswers).

mutants.name: web1-put-served
mutants.rule: PUT, DELETE and PATCH on a route are 405 as POST is (law OtherMethodIsNotAllowed only: the fixture posts).

mutants.name: web1-failure-answered-200
mutants.rule: A loader's failure answers with the status its table gives, never 200 (law KnownPathIsLoadThenView; FixtureSiteAnswers).

mutants.name: web1-not-html
mutants.rule: A page is text/html in UTF-8 (law KnownPathIsLoadThenView only).

mutants.name: web1-to-ignores-route
mutants.rule: To links to the route's own place (FixtureSiteAnswers reads the link).

mutants.name: web1-webtest-head-gets
mutants.rule: webtest.Head asks HEAD (FixtureSiteAnswers only: the laws call Fetch).

mutants.name: web1-parse-trailing-segment
mutants.rule: A route's Parse takes no trailing segment: /notes/a/extra is the 404 page (FixtureSiteAnswers).

mutants.name: web1-empty-slug-unparsed
mutants.rule: The note of the empty slug parses from /notes, where Href puts it (law Routes.HrefParses for routes only).

mutants.name: web1-status-case-wildcard
mutants.from:
case gone as g:
				web.Reply{Status: 410, Page: html.Text(g.Slug)}
mutants.rule: A status table answers each failure by name, so a new variant does not compile until it has a page (the diagnostics case web-failure-without-status).
